deals: select d.pc_0012_id as id, d.name, d.stage, d.amount, d.currency, d.amount_base, d.weighted_amount, d.pwin, d.bant_total, d.product_category, d.product_category__label as category, d.customer_type, d.customer_type__label as customer_type_label, d.contract_vehicle__label as vehicle, d.region, d.region__label as region_label, d.owner, d.owner__label as owner_name, d.next_step, d.next_step_date, d.close_date, d.solicitation_number, d.updated_at, (select c.name from associations a join companies c on c.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'deals' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = d.pc_0012_id order by c.name limit 1) as company from deals d where d.pipeline = 'defense' order by d.amount_base desc nulls last, d.name
stages: select api_value, label, is_closed, is_won, color from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property = 'stage' and record_status = 'active' and 'defense' = any(parent_values) order by display_order
filters: select property, api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property in ('product_category', 'customer_type', 'region') and record_status = 'active' order by property, display_order
users: select pc_0000_id as id, name from users where status = 'active' union select owner, owner__label from deals where owner is not null and pipeline = 'defense' order by 2
base: select code from currencies where is_base

detail_contacts.sql: select distinct ct.pc_0010_id as id, ct.name, ct.job_title, ct.email, ct.phone, a.label from associations a join contacts ct on ct.pc_0010_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'deals' and a.other_object = 'contacts' and a.record_id = :deal order by ct.name

detail_stage_since.sql: select h.changed_at from property_history h where h.object = 'deals' and h.property = 'stage' and h.record_id = :deal order by h.changed_at desc, h.history_id desc limit 1

detail_escalations.sql: select e.{{id:escalations}} as id, e.name, e.status, e.status__label as status_label, e.roadblocks__label as roadblocks, e.created_at from associations a join escalations e on e.{{id:escalations}} = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'deals' and a.other_object = 'escalations' and a.record_id = :deal order by e.created_at desc

roadblocks: select api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = '{{code:escalations}}' and property = 'roadblocks' and record_status = 'active' order by display_order
companies: select c.pc_0011_id as id, c.name from companies c where c.name is not null order by c.name limit 2000
